items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 29, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I’ll never say, “hey could you play more like Freddie Green?”

ctx.x: But I’m not going to tell anybody how to play. I might ask for someone to play softer, but I’ll never say, “hey could you play more like Freddie Green?” I don’t think that’s right. © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
“Could you play more like Ben Riley?” “Well why don’t you call Ben Riley if you wanted that?” I mean I had the good fortune to record with Ben Riley.
